te: Meeting 1/2567 · Subcommittee on Whole-System Water Management, Pollution and Environment
Progress of the subcommittees and working group
se: Meeting on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 15.00, committee meeting room CA 427, Floor 4, Parliament House. According to the meeting notice, the agenda is the progress of the subcommittees and working group. The summary will be added after the Senate publishes it.
it: Progress of the subcommittees and working group

te: Pre-meeting video · Progress of the subcommittees and working group
Progress: SMR from the Republic of Korea, ESCO measures for state agencies, and community waste power plants
se: The committee heard progress from its subcommittees and working group. The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy heard a major electricity producer of the Republic of Korea on small modular reactor technology (i-SMR) and its cooperation with EGAT under a memorandum of understanding signed in June 2025. The subcommittee on price and power sector structures studied energy service company (ESCO) measures for state agencies, hearing the Department of Alternative Energy Development and Efficiency and the Comptroller General's Department. It found that the main obstacle is that there are no rules yet for state agencies to engage private ESCOs, so it suggested that the agencies concerned speed up specific rules and let private firms compete on price. The subcommittee on community waste considered its draft policy report on community waste power plants, grouping projects into 4 groups by their actual status, and suggested that any cut in the FiT rate go together with a change in the waste disposal fee (tipping fee). The working group on bamboo as an energy crop is preparing its report.
it: Cooperation on i-SMR technology between an electricity producer of the Republic of Korea and EGAT
Energy service company (ESCO) measures for state agencies (DEDE, Comptroller General's Department)
Draft policy report on community waste power plants
Report on promoting bamboo as an energy crop (in preparation)

te: Meeting summary video · Progress: SMR from the Republic of Korea, ESCO measures for state agencies, and community waste power plants
SMR technology from a foreign developer, and progress on a complaint
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy heard an SMR technology developer from the United States on its technology and legal steps, and the subcommittee on price and power sector structures reported progress on a complaint about a power plant, using information from EPPO, the ERC and the Royal Irrigation Department (the part the subcommittee considered in closed session is not shown).
it: SMR technology and legal steps (foreign developer)
Progress on a complaint about a power plant

te: Meeting summary video · SMR technology from a foreign developer, and progress on a complaint
EGAT prepares for the SMR policy
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy heard EGAT on its preparations for the policy to promote SMR technology, such as four working groups on feasibility, site study and selection, public understanding and participation, and other preparations, and the committee heard progress from the price, waste and bamboo energy groups.
it: Progress of the subcommittees and working group

te: Meeting summary video · EGAT prepares for the SMR policy
State budgets for household rooftop solar
se: The committee continued studying policy to promote household rooftop solar, with the Ministry of Interior, the Metropolitan Electricity Authority (MEA) and the Provincial Electricity Authority (PEA) explaining, and heard progress from the three subcommittees and the bamboo energy working group.
it: Household rooftop solar policy (Ministry of Interior, MEA, PEA)
Progress of the subcommittees and working group

te: Meeting summary video · State budgets for household rooftop solar
Rooftop solar for households, and progress of three subcommittees
se: The committee began studying policy to promote rooftop solar power for households, especially using state budgets to support installation, and heard progress from the subcommittees on SMR, on price and power sector structures and on community waste, and from the working group on promoting bamboo as an energy crop.
it: Policy to promote household rooftop solar
Progress of the three subcommittees and the bamboo energy working group

te: Meeting summary video · Rooftop solar for households, and progress of three subcommittees
A proposal to regulate data centres as a type of factory
se: The subcommittee on price and power sector structures summarised its observations on the data centre industry, such as listing data centres as a factory type in the ministerial regulation under the factory law, and the community waste subcommittee set a meeting on related policy.
it: Observations and proposals on the data centre industry
Meeting date of the community waste subcommittee

te: SMR and the navy, a complaint about a power plant in Chachoengsao, and the waste report
se: The subcommittee on laws for new alternative energy heard the Naval Operations Department on developing SMR technology. The subcommittee on price and power sector structures considered a complaint asking for a check of a fuel change and power purchase contract of a power plant project in Chachoengsao, hearing EPPO and other agencies, and the community waste subcommittee set the scope and timeline of its report.
it: Complaint about a power plant's fuel change, Chachoengsao
Scope of the report on community waste management for electricity
